<div class="card-body">
'''Rogue 2''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ローグ2</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ゼヴが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。パイロットが乗っているなら、捜索隊の運命数に2を加えられる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-2-PSA-82917284.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型。ホスの寒冷対策に施した改造が成功した最初のスノースピーダー。ゼヴ・セネスカが操縦する。ソロ船長とスカイウォーカー中佐の捜索隊を率いた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rogue 2.

'''Card text:'''
May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Zev is piloting. If a pilot is aboard, may add 2 to search party destiny.

'''Lore:'''
Enclosed. The first snowspeeder whose Hoth cold-weather modifications succeeded. Zev Senesca pilots it. He led the search party for Captain Solo and Commander Skywalker.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore specifies successful cold-weather modifications rather than being adapted to Hoth's environment, and uses 中佐.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue 2]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
